projects.name: Image Denoising
projects.summary: Research at Beijing Institute of Technology and the University of Würzburg.
highlights: Developed contrastive learning methods for fine-grained noise estimation and camera-specific noise synthesis, enabling **calibration-free denoising** (CVPR 2022, TPAMI 2025).
Designed an iterative denoiser and noise estimator for **self-supervised learning** from individual noisy images (ICCV 2023).

projects.name: HDR Image and Video Reconstruction
projects.summary: Research at Beijing Institute of Technology and the University of Würzburg, in collaboration with the University of Tokyo.
highlights: Built an optical system and **paired high-speed HDR video/event dataset**, and developed recurrent reconstruction models (CVPR 2021, TPAMI 2025).
Collected paired RAW/HDR data and developed intensity and spatial guidance for reconstruction from a **single RAW image** (ICCV 2023).
Contributed to a **key NSFC project** on computational imaging for lunar exploration; two first-author works supported its imaging algorithms.

projects.name: Low-Light Image and Video Enhancement
projects.summary: Research at Beijing Institute of Technology in collaboration with Huawei Hangzhou Research Institute and Huawei Noah's Ark Lab.
highlights: Developed and evaluated physics-based **sensor noise modeling and calibration** methods.
Studied RAW-domain video enhancement using real noise analysis, paired video acquisition, and **lightweight re-parameterized networks**.
Mentored work on a **3D deformable U-Net** for low-light video enhancement (PRCV 2021).

projects.name: Hyperspectral Reconstruction and Classification
projects.summary: Research at Beijing Institute of Technology in collaboration with the University of Tokyo.
highlights: Studied **learned illumination** for spectral reflectance recovery (Optics Express 2019).
Developed **illumination modulation** for reflective/fluorescent separation (Optics Letters 2020).
Learned **camera spectral responses** and spectral-spatial features for efficient hyperspectral classification (Remote Sensing 2020).
